name: EXPLORE_REPOSITORY
definition: Survey repository structure/files to orient before acting.

name: LOCATE_CODE
definition: Search the codebase for the file/symbol/definition relevant to the task.

name: READ_SOURCE
definition: Open and read a source, test, or doc file to understand its implementation/behavior.

name: RUN_TEST_SUITE
definition: Execute the project test suite (or a test file) to observe pass/fail status.

name: REPRODUCE_ISSUE
definition: Run a command/script to trigger and observe the reported bug.

name: WRITE_REPRODUCTION_SCRIPT
definition: Create a script/file that reproduces the bug for repeatable checking.

name: DIAGNOSE_FAILURE
definition: Inspect failing output (traceback, diff, assertion) to identify the cause; follows a failure.

name: ADD_DEBUG_INSTRUMENTATION
definition: Insert temporary prints/logging/asserts to investigate behavior (not the fix itself).

name: EDIT_SOURCE
definition: Modify source code to change behavior toward fixing the issue.
typical_triggers: str_replace_editor str_replace/insert on a source file

name: WRITE_TEST
definition: Add a new or regression test that guards the intended behavior.

name: INSTALL_DEPENDENCY
definition: Install or configure packages / environment needed to run the code or tests.

name: REFACTOR_CODE
definition: Restructure code without changing externally observable behavior.
typical_triggers: edits that rename/move/reorganize without altering outputs

name: REVERT_CHANGE
definition: Undo a previous edit that did not work or caused a regression.

name: CLEANUP_ARTIFACTS
definition: Remove temporary/scratch files (repro scripts, debug output) before finalizing.

name: VERIFY_FIX
definition: Re-run the reproduction or relevant tests to confirm the change resolves the issue.
typical_triggers: re-run repro / pytest after an edit, observing success

name: SUBMIT_SOLUTION
definition: Finalize and submit the patch as the solution.
